reason: Explain why this protected change is necessary.
backup_or_recovery: Identify verified backup, recovery media, or replacement-only recovery.
out_of_band_access: Identify console and recovery access if networking or boot fails.
prechecks: Record relevant health and configuration evidence.
implementation_steps: List exact bounded commands and stopping points.
validation_steps: Define success checks and evidence to retain.
rollback_triggers: Define the condition that stops the change and begins rollback.
rollback_steps: Define tested rollback or recovery steps.
